channel.title: The Grant Desk - Prizes and Awards, AI, Tech & Research, EU, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Prizes and Awards, AI, Tech & Research, EU, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research prize - week of 01 Jun 2026
item.description:
• We Are Human Festival 2026: Call for Films (Paris)
    https://wearehuman.foundation/en/call-for-films/
    We Are Human Foundation · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · Grand Prix EUR 5,000; Best Screenplay EUR 3,000; Ethics Award EUR 2,000. No submission fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research prize - week of 18 May 2026
item.description:
• Council of Europe: New Democratic Pact for Europe Democracy Hackathon 2026 (Strasbourg)
    https://democracyhackathon.coe.int/
    Council of Europe (under the Monaco Presidency of the Committee of Ministers), in partnership with No Hate Speech Week and Microsoft · deadline Closed 05 Jun 2026 · EUR 50,000 Microsoft-funded prize pool distributed among winning teams. Travel and accommodation covered for the 20 selected finalist teams. No application fee.
